title: A Study of TL-895 in Myelofibrosis, Indolent Systemic Mastocytosis, Monoclonal Mast Cell Activation Syndrome, or Non-Monoclonal Mast Cell Activation Syndrome
official: A Phase 2 Multicenter Study of TL-895 in Subjects with Myelofibrosis, Indolent Systemic Mastocytosis, Monoclonal Mast Cell Activation Syndrome, or Non-Monoclonal Mast Cell Activation Syndrome
summary:
Main objective: Part A: Cohorts 1-4: To determine the recommended phase 2 dose and schedule of TL-895 in each cohort.
Part A: Cohort 5: To determine the recommended TL-895 dosing regimen(s).
Part A: Cohort 6: To determine the recommended phase 3 dose of TL-895.
Part B: Cohorts 1-4: Improvement in Total Symptom Score at Week 24
Part B: Cohort 5: To assess changes in ISM symptoms after treatment with TL-895.
Part B  Cohort 6: To assess changes in MCAS symptoms after treatment with TL-895.
Part C: Cohort 5: To compare changes in ISM symptoms after treatment with TL-895 vs TL-895 placebo.
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Cohorts 1-6: Adults ≥18 years of age
2. Cohort 4 only: Ineligibility for JAKi treatment with a platelet count of ≥ 15 and < 25x10^9/L
3. Cohort 6: Moderate-to-severe chronic MCAS symptoms
4. Cohort 6: Subject must have failed to achieve symptom control for one or more baseline chronic symptoms
5. Cohort 6: The subject’s symptomatic MCAS therapies must be stable
6. Cohorts 1-4: Confirmed diagnosis of PMF, post-PV MF, or post-ET MF, as assessed by treating physician according to the World Health Organization (WHO) criteria
7. Cohorts 1-4: High-risk, intermediate-2 risk, or intermediate-1 risk, defined by DIPSS
8. Cohorts 1-6: Adequate hematologic, hepatic, and renal functions
9. Cohorts 1-4: MF symptoms as defined by having at least 2 symptoms with an average baseline (Day -7 to Day -1) score of at least 1 for each of the 2 symptoms per MFSAF v4.0
10. Cohort 3 only: Ineligibility for JAKi treatment with a platelet count of ≥ 25 and < 50 x 10^9/L
11. Cohort 5: Confirmed diagnosis of ISM as defined by WHO diagnostic criteria based on review of bone marrow biopsy pathology report results
12. Cohort 5: Subject must have moderate-to-severe symptoms
13. Cohort 6: Confirmed diagnosis of MCAS as defined by Working Group diagnostic criteria
Exclusion criteria:
1. Cohorts 1-4: Prior treatment with JAKi within 28 days prior to first study treatment
2. Cohorts 1-4: Prior splenectomy or splenic irradiation within 24 weeks prior to first dose of study treatment
3. Cohort 5: Diagnosis with another myeloid disorder
4. Cohort 6: A current diagnosis of cutaneous or systemic mastocytosis as defined by WHO criteria
